Not only did Lara lend her beautiful voice to this duet, but she also directed, filmed, and edited the entire video. Her artistry—both on camera and behind the scenes—truly brought this project to life. It's been a longtime dream come true to work with Lara and witness her level of professionalism firsthand.

snippet.title: [그렉]if...? l 만약 보고싶다가 듀엣곡이라면?
snippet.description:
From. 그렉형
만약 "보고싶다"가 듀엣곡이라면?
요즘 AI보이스로 노래만들기가 핫하죠!
저도 직접 리소스를 만들어서 제작해보았는데요.

최근 일본을 다녀와서 가장 감명깊었던
일본 도쿄의 낮과 밤 사진 1장씩을 이용해서 만들어봤어요.

AI 보이스를 이용한 IF 시리즈 첫번째, 즐겁게 감상해주세요 :)

본 영상의 모든 리소스는 직접 제작하여 사용하였습니다.(사진, 보이스 등)

From Greg
 What if “Bogoshipda (I Miss You)” was a duet?

AI voice song-making is such a hot trend these days, right?
So I created all the resources myself and produced this version! 

I recently traveled to Japan, and I used two photos I took in Tokyo — one in the daytime and one at night — to bring this piece to life. 

This is the very first episode of my AI Voice “IF Series.”
Hope you enjoy it, and let me know what you think in the comments! :)

All photos, voices, and resources in this video were created by GREG.

snippet.title: ON MY MIND – Greg ft. Lara Benito | Cover Song
snippet.description:
I’m beyond excited to share this heartfelt cover of “On My Mind” with the incredibly talented Lara Benito.

Not only did Lara lend her beautiful voice to this duet, but she also directed, filmed, and edited the entire video. Her artistry—both on camera and behind the scenes—truly brought this project to life. It's been a longtime dream come true to work with Lara and witness her level of professionalism firsthand.

We had a great time creating this together and hope it moves you the way it moved us.
If you enjoyed this, don’t miss our emotional duet of my new single “보고싶다” on her channel!

• YouTube: 나야 라라 LaraLand
• Instagram: @laraland_official

🎧 Vocals: Greg & Lara Benito
